entities.name: Central Industrial Security Force
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Central Industrial Security Force (CISF) is a central armed police force in India, under the Ministry of Home Affairs. CISF's primary mission is to provide security policing services to large institutions, whether state-owned or privately owned.
